title: All models
lede: The figures that decide the choice, in catalog order. Full specifications on pages 18 to 20; definitions and the repeatability method on page 22.
note1: Regional 2σ on a ceramic reference plate; the largest value found at the near, optimum and far working distance; method on page 22.
note2: TRS-050B and TRS-075B: near and far working distances on request; measuring depth 8 mm.
note3: PRS: preliminary specification; Z repeatability method and points per frame stated at launch.
select_1: Choose a field of view that covers the part with margin at the optimum working distance.
select_2: Choose a point spacing of one tenth of the smallest feature or finer.
select_3: Choose a Z repeatability of one tenth of the tolerance or better; a gauge study on the part decides.
ask_desc_a: Send a photograph of the part, the feature and its tolerance to
ask_desc_b: We come back with the model and the working distance, and say what the camera will and will not resolve.
